name: roost-tmux-tabs
description: One VS Code terminal tab per window of the `main` tmux session, kept in sync.

roostTmuxTabs.baseSession.description: tmux base session whose windows become tabs.

enumDescriptions: Open in the terminal panel (tabs listed on the panel side).
Open in the editor area (each tab is an editor tab).
roostTmuxTabs.location.description: Where to open the terminal tabs. 'editor' makes each tab an editor-area tab (top tab bar, alongside files); 'panel' docks them in the bottom terminal panel.

roostTmuxTabs.autoSync.description: Re-sync when the VS Code window regains focus, and poll while focused.

roostTmuxTabs.pollSeconds.description: While focused, re-sync every N seconds so new/closed agents appear/disappear on their own. 0 disables polling (focus + manual only).

roostTmuxTabs.liveTitle.description: Show the live pane title (Claude session name + working spinner) as the tab label, updated in place. Requires terminal.integrated.tabs.title to include "${sequence}". Turn off to pin a clean static session-title name instead (correct name, but no live working indicator).

roostTmuxTabs.hideStatusBar.description: Hide the tmux status bar inside each tab (the VS Code tab already labels it).

roostTmuxTabs.pinWindows.description: Keep each tab locked to its window: when the window closes (or you switch inside the tab) the tab self-destructs instead of drifting to show a neighbouring window. Disable for free window-switching inside a tab (reintroduces the brief wrong-window flash on close).

roostTmuxTabs.singleAttach.description: Keep at most one "attach main" terminal. With that profile as terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.linux, every new-terminal gesture (and every reload) opens another identical view of main's current window; with this on, the surplus tab is closed and the existing one focused instead. Turn off if you want several attach views (e.g. on different windows side by side).

roostTmuxTabs.excludeNames.description: Window names to skip (exact match), e.g. ["shell"] to not surface the utility window.

roostTmuxTabs.debug.description: Log tab opens/drops (with reasons)/sweeps/window-set changes to ~/.roost-tmux-tabs.log for troubleshooting. `tail -f ~/.roost-tmux-tabs.log` while reproducing a glitch. Set false once things are stable.
